comments.content: The ternary with comma operator is used as the format argument to snprintf. `server.hide_user_data_from_log ? ("fmt", arg) : ("fmt", ...)` evaluates to the value of the comma expression, i.e. sdslen(...) or the last pointer, so snprintf receives a size_t/char* as its format string. This is UB/crash and the %zu argument for the redacted case is never passed to snprintf. Use an if/else or select the format string first and then call snprintf with matching arguments.
